headline: Tejas Networks and Qualcomm showcase 6G ISAC technology
hook: Joint demonstration at India Mobile Congress 2026
summary: Tejas Networks and Qualcomm have jointly demonstrated 6G Integrated Sensing and Communications technology at the India Mobile Congress 2026. The announcement was officially communicated to the stock exchanges via a press release dated October 8, 2026. This collaboration highlights ongoing research and development efforts in next-generation telecom standards by the companies. Indian retail investors tracking telecom equipment and technology stocks can note this as a progressive tech milestone.
why_it_matters: Tech validation for Tejas in next-gen 6G standards
winners_losers: Tejas Networks and Qualcomm gain / none hurt
